subject: How can I specify phenotype column from original cross object in makeqtl and fitqtl?

messages.author: cfe54b4291e451b2
messages.subject: How can I specify phenotype column from original cross object in makeqtl and fitqtl?
parts: I am trying to fit qtl models, but I have multiple phenotypes in my original cross object. I cannot seem to specify the lodcolumn in the makeqtl or fitqtl functions. Do I need to? I assume they default to my first phenotype column because I get bad fits for models I assume have strong support in the data. Is there a way to specify the phenotype for makeqtl and fitqtl, or is there a way to quickly subset out my phenotypes of interest from my original cross object?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How can I specify phenotype column from original cross object in makeqtl and fitqtl?
parts:
makeqtl doesn't need to know about the phenotype.

In fitqtl, the argument is pheno.col, just as in scanone.

karl
